# BVLVO

> BVLVO is an early-stage research project exploring an open economic protocol for Personal AI Economy / Machine Labor Economy. The current editorial parent is Research V1.1; 13 independent papers are V0.2 drafts; the proposed Personal AI prototype is V0.1 and has not been implemented or run.

## Current research
- [Overview](https://bvlvo.com/): BVLVO — The Economic Layer for Personal AI.
- [Research V1.1](https://bvlvo.com/research/): Research framework, 13-paper index, current question, related work and revision record.
- [Research and development](https://bvlvo.com/development/): Current development status and preserved engineering history.
- [Status and disclosures](https://bvlvo.com/disclosures/): Research limits, project status, archived material and authenticity guidance.

## Research boundaries
- Design principles are project constraints, not claims of originality or implementation.
- Finding related work does not make the complete proposal non-original.
- Not finding a precedent does not establish originality.
- The proposed Personal AI prototype has not produced experimental results.
- No production protocol, official token, public network, sale or purchase route exists.
- Token necessity remains an open research question; a no-token path remains in scope.
- No completed legal review, production security audit or compatibility certification is claimed.

## Historical engineering archive
- [Testnet engineering record](https://bvlvo.com/development/testnet-status/): Earlier token, vesting and reserve-control rehearsal evidence. It is not the current product roadmap, a production deployment or an independent audit.
- Earlier token, governance, treasury, issuance and task pages are superseded research records. Their dates, allocations and parameters are not current commitments.
